title: One-Step Replay on Regular States
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $c$ be a four-tape configuration of the table interpreter on $x$, and let $w$ be a Boolean clock word. If $c$ is live and its control is not a state carrying a decoded transition record, then one step of the timed interpreter from the six-tape lift of $c$ with clock word $w$ equals the six-tape lift, with the same clock word, of one step of the stopped table interpreter from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: the control of $c$ is not a decoded-record application state
replaced:
For every live four-tape configuration whose control is not a pending-action
state, one step of the timed interpreter from its six-tape lift (with any
clock word) equals the lift of one step of the stopped table interpreter, with
the same clock word.
